best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron that has dendritic arborization in medulla layers M1-M3, as well as presynaptic sites in M8 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Gao et al., 2008). In the medulla, it spans just one column (Kind et al., 2021), and receives input from lamina monopolar neuron L3 (Takemura et al., 2013) and an R8 photoreceptor (Kind et al., 2021). Its axon follows the anterior edge of its cognate medulla column (Ting et al., 2014), then crosses the second optic chiasma and projects to lobula layer 5 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Gao et al., 2008). It provides input to the lobula intrinsic neuron Li4 via many synapses (Lin et al., 2016). It is a cholinergic neuron (Gao et al., 2008). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00003808 'transmedullary neuron Tm20', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
